name: segmented-text-field
description: The shared segment base: a row of editable segments, each its own rounded cell. date-field, time-field and date-picker copy this anatomy rather than reference it.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Unstyled root that holds the row of segments.

anatomy.name: segment
anatomy.description: One editable piece of a structured value, drawn as its own rounded cell (RSP DateSegment, 2px radius). Repeated once per entry of the segments option.

anatomy.name: value
anatomy.description: Text of a segment: its value, or its format text while the segment is empty (isPlaceholder). A separator entry (isLiteral) draws only this text.

anatomyReview.notes: Owner decision A9 (2026-11-20): this component is the shared segment base that date-field, time-field and date-picker copy. No Figma page of its own. The root container is unstyled; the rounding sits on segment (RSP DateSegment radius 2px). The deprecated gap record is a frozen archive.

segments.description: The segments, in reading order. Each entry is drawn as one copy of the segment part; the request supplies them. A literal entry is a separator drawn as plain text.

label.description: The text drawn in the segment, or the separator when isLiteral is true.

isPlaceholder.description: Whether the segment is empty and shows its format text.

isLiteral.description: Whether the entry is a separator between segments, drawn as plain text without a segment cell.

isPlaceholder.description: Whether the rendered segment is empty and shows its format text. Per-segment in a data-driven component is segments[].isPlaceholder.

isLiteral.description: Whether the rendered entry is a separator. Per-segment in a data-driven component is segments[].isLiteral.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The segments. Each entry of the segments option is drawn as one copy of the segment part, in order.
